ActorTalk: I've never regretted the path I've walked. What's done is done.
But if you asked whether I have any regrets... I suppose I do.
Would you like to tell me about it?
I appreciate you asking. If there's one thing I look back on from my time at F.O.S., it's that I never joined a single student club.
Reading and playing chess with an AI was pleasant, but it lacked the interpersonal interaction of spending time with others.
Well, for chess, or anything else, my door's always open.
So... spending time with a junior is your way of catching up on the F.O.S. youth you missed, huh?
In that case, shall we pick up where we left off with our game after duty today?
No, that wasn't my intention at all. If I gave you that impression, I apologize. The last thing I want is to use a personal connection to compensate for my own choices.
My time with you... it means more to me than just filling some gap in the past.
Don't apologize. I was only teasing.
